Benchmark Screening Methods: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis

Source: R/62-BenchGSEA.R
BenchGSEA.Rd

Runs gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) on the marker genes of every screening method present in the input, so that the functional signals recovered by different methods can be compared side by side.

Usage

BenchGSEA(obj, ...)

# S3 method for class 'Seurat'
BenchGSEA(
  obj,
  group,
  pathway,
  p_value_threshold = NULL,
  ...,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose")
)

# S3 method for class '`SigBridgeR::ScreenMethodResult`'
BenchGSEA(obj, ...)

# S3 method for class '`SigBridgeR::BenchGSEAConfig`'
BenchGSEA(obj, ..., verbose = getFuncOption("verbose"))

# Default S3 method
BenchGSEA(obj, ...)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat object whose meta.data contains screening method results (columns named after screening methods, e.g. "Scissor"), a ScreenMethodResult object, or a BenchGSEAConfig object.

...

Additional arguments, automatically split by formal argument names between Seurat::FindMarkers() and fgsea::fgsea() (including fgsea::fgseaMultilevel() / fgsea::fgseaSimple()). ident.1, ident.2 and group.by are reserved by BenchGSEA and must not be supplied.

group

A vector of length equal to the number of cells, with each element being the group label of the corresponding cell.

pathway

A named list of gene sets, each element a character vector of gene symbols. Passed to fgsea::fgsea().

p_value_threshold

Numeric or NULL. When not NULL, markers are filtered by adjusted p-value (p_val_adj < 0.05) before ranking. Default: NULL.

verbose

Logical. Whether to report progress. Default: TRUE.

Value

A data.table of fgsea::fgsea() results stacked across screening methods, with an extra screenMethod column identifying the method and a leadingEdgeStats list column holding the ranking statistics of the leading-edge genes. Methods without markers are dropped with a warning.

Details

For each screening method found in meta.data:

  1. Labels are binarised to "Positive" vs "Other";

  2. Seurat::FindMarkers() is run with ident.1 = "Positive", ident.2 = "Other" and group.by set to the method column;

  3. Markers are ranked by sign(avg_log2FC) * -log10(p_val_adj);

  4. fgsea::fgsea() is run on the ranked list, and the ranking statistics of the leading-edge genes are attached as leadingEdgeStats.

For a BenchGSEAConfig input, every configured screening method is first run via Screen() on the same data before the GSEA comparison.

See also

BenchGSEAConfig(), Screen(), fgsea::fgsea(), Seurat::FindMarkers(), BenchAcc(), BenchMemory()

Other Benchmark: BenchAcc(), BenchGeneScore(), BenchMemory()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# sc is a Seurat object already screened by e.g. Scissor and scPAS
pathways <- list(
  pathway_a = c("Gene1", "Gene2", "Gene3"),
  pathway_b = c("Gene4", "Gene5", "Gene6")
)
res <- BenchGSEA(sc, pathway = pathways)
} # }
